declarations.docstring: A coercion from the indicated subtype sends a vector in the given weight submodule to a vector in the corresponding target weight submodule.
If a finite family of weight vectors has a span stable under the general linear group action, then every member of the family lies in the image of the displayed algebra map.
Under the stated weight and span-stability assumptions, the action on each polynomial in the family is given by evaluating a polynomial in the entries of every invertible matrix.
Under the stated weight and span-stability assumptions, the value of each family member at an invertible matrix is obtained by evaluating a polynomial in that matrix's entries.
A vector belongs to the specified weight space exactly when every one-coordinate diagonal unit acts by the scalar prescribed by that weight.
